data pre process
```{r}
# =========================
# 0) Libraries
# =========================
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(randomForest)
library(lubridate)

# =========================
# 1) Read data
# =========================
df_weather     <- read_csv("weather2024_3-5.csv")
df_stat_info   <- read_csv("資科期末_data/ntu_area_ubike_stations_sorted.csv")
df_stat_flow_m3<- read_csv("資科期末_data/station_flow_202403_new.csv")
df_stat_flow_m4<- read_csv("資科期末_data/station_flow_202404_new.csv")
df_stat_flow_m5<- read_csv("資科期末_data/station_flow_202405_new.csv")

# =========================
# 2) 只抓前 10 個站 (flow 與 info 同步)
# =========================
df_stat_flow_m3 <- df_stat_flow_m3[df_stat_flow_m3$station %in% unique(df_stat_flow_m3$station)[1:10], ]
df_stat_flow_m4 <- df_stat_flow_m4[df_stat_flow_m4$station %in% unique(df_stat_flow_m4$station)[1:10], ]
df_stat_flow_m5 <- df_stat_flow_m5[df_stat_flow_m5$station %in% unique(df_stat_flow_m5$station)[1:10], ]

df_stat_info <- df_stat_info[df_stat_info$sna %in% unique(df_stat_info$sna)[1:10], ]
df_stat_info$sna <- gsub("^YouBike2\\.0_", "", df_stat_info$sna)

# =========================
# 3) 合併三個月份的 flow
# =========================
df_all <- bind_rows(df_stat_flow_m3, df_stat_flow_m4, df_stat_flow_m5) %>%
  arrange(station, date, hour)

# =========================
# 4) 併上天氣（處理 24 點 → 0 點後對齊）
# =========================
df_weather$`觀測時間(hour)`[ df_weather$`觀測時間(hour)` == 24 ] <- 0

df_merged <- df_all %>%
  left_join(df_weather, by = c("date" = "日期", "hour" = "觀測時間(hour)")) %>%
  select(-`Unnamed: 0`) %>%
  left_join(df_stat_info, by = c("station" = "sna"))

# =========================
# 5) 簡單缺值處理與刪除不需要的欄位（站點靜態欄）
# =========================
df_merged <- df_merged %>%
  tidyr::drop_na() %>%
  select(-c(sno, sarea, latitude, longitude, ar, sareaen, aren, act))

# =========================
# 6) 新增三項時間特徵與淨借車量
# =========================
# -- 6.1 官方假日與補班日（請依需要補齊）
tw_holidays <- as_date(c(
  "2024-01-01",
  "2024-02-08","2024-02-09","2024-02-12","2024-02-13","2024-02-14",
  "2024-02-28",
  "2024-04-04","2024-04-05",
  "2024-06-10",
  "2024-09-17",
  "2024-10-10"
))

tw_makeup_workdays <- as_date(c(
  "2024-02-17", "2024-09-14"
))

# -- 6.2 產生時間特徵與 net_borrow
df_merged <- df_merged %>%
  mutate(
    date = as_date(date),
    hour = as.integer(hour),

    # 週/月/年內日
    wday_num = as.integer(strftime(date, "%u")),   # 1=Mon ... 7=Sun
    is_weekend = wday_num >= 6L,
    week  = isoweek(date),
    month = month(date),
    yday  = yday(date),

    # 假日/補班
    is_official_holiday = date %in% tw_holidays,
    is_makeup_workday   = date %in% tw_makeup_workdays,
    is_holiday_taipei   = (is_weekend | is_official_holiday) & !is_makeup_workday,
    is_holiday_eve      = (date + days(1)) %in% tw_holidays,

    # 尖峰
    is_peak_morning = if_else(is_holiday_taipei, hour %in% 8:9, hour %in% 7:8),
    is_peak_evening = hour %in% 17:19,
    is_peak_any     = is_peak_morning | is_peak_evening,
    is_peak_noon    = hour %in% 12,

    # 深夜
    night = as.integer(hour %in% c(0:5, 23)),

    # 淨借車
    net_borrow = borrow_count - return_count
  ) %>%
  # -- 6.3 刪除中介欄位與不需要欄
  select(-c(wday_num, is_weekend, week, month, yday,
            is_official_holiday, is_makeup_workday, is_holiday_eve)) %>%
  select(-c(`最大瞬間風風向(360degree)`,
            `風向(360degree)`,
            `露點溫度(℃)`,
            `海平面氣壓(hPa)`))

# -- 6.4 降水量 "T" → 0
df_merged$`降水量(mm)`[ df_merged$`降水量(mm)` == "T" ] <- 0

# =========================
# 7) 統一變數命名（最後一步）
# =========================
df_merged <- df_merged %>%
  rename(
    station_pressure = `測站氣壓(hPa)`,
    temperature      = `氣溫(℃)`,
    humidity         = `相對溼度(%)`,
    wind_speed       = `風速(m/s)`,
    max_wind_speed   = `最大瞬間風(m/s)`,
    rainfall         = `降水量(mm)`,
    rain_duration    = `降水時數(h)`,
    solar_radiation  = `全天空日射量(MJ/㎡)`,
    uv_index         = 紫外線指數
  )


```



run RF model with cross validation(5-fold)
```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ranger)
set.seed(42)

# ==== 基本設定 ====
dt <- as.data.table(df_merged)
targets      <- c("borrow_count", "return_count")
exclude_cols <- c("station","date","hour", targets)
features     <- setdiff(names(dt), exclude_cols)
K <- 5  # blocked 5-fold，每折測試 20%


# 字串轉因子（一次處理）
for (nm in features) if (is.character(dt[[nm]])) dt[, (nm) := as.factor(get(nm))]

stations <- unique(dt$station)

# ==== 主程式：僅計算 pooled 指標 ====
out_list <- list()

for (st in stations) {
  d <- dt[station == st][order(date, hour)]
  n <- nrow(d)
  if (n < 80) next  # 測試集要有 20% 的量

  # 5 個連續測試區段
  cuts <- floor(n * (0:K) / K)
  test_ranges <- lapply(seq_len(K), function(i) c(cuts[i] + 1L, if (i < K) cuts[i+1L] else n))

  for (y in targets) {
    fml <- as.formula(paste(y, "~", paste(features, collapse = " + ")))

    # 累計器（只為 pooled 指標）
    sse_total <- 0
    sae_total <- 0
    n_test_total <- 0
    sum_y  <- 0
    sum_y2 <- 0

    for (i in seq_len(K)) {
      te_st <- test_ranges[[i]][1]
      te_en <- test_ranges[[i]][2]
      te_idx <- te_st:te_en
      tr_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(n), te_idx)
      if (length(te_idx) < 5 || length(tr_idx) < 10) next

      tr <- d[tr_idx]
      te <- d[te_idx]

      rf <- ranger(
        formula     = fml,
        data        = tr,
        num.trees   = 1000,           # 較快、CV 夠用
        importance  = "none",
        num.threads = 0,             # 用滿 CPU
        respect.unordered.factors = "order",
        seed        = 42 + i
      )

      pred <- predict(rf, te)$predictions
      y_te <- te[[y]]

      err <- y_te - pred
      sse_total    <- sse_total + sum(err^2)
      sae_total    <- sae_total + sum(abs(err))
      n_test_total <- n_test_total + length(y_te)
      sum_y        <- sum_y + sum(y_te)
      sum_y2       <- sum_y2 + sum(y_te^2)
    }

    if (n_test_total > 0) {
      ybar_all  <- sum_y / n_test_total
      tss_total <- sum_y2 - n_test_total * (ybar_all^2)
      R2_pooled    <- if (tss_total > 0) 1 - (sse_total / tss_total) else NA_real_
      RMSE_pooled  <- sqrt(sse_total / n_test_total)
      MAE_weighted <- sae_total / n_test_total
    } else {
      R2_pooled <- RMSE_pooled <- MAE_weighted <- NA_real_
    }

    out_list[[paste(st, y, sep = " :: ")]] <- data.table(
      station = st, target = y,
      RMSE_pooled = RMSE_pooled,
      MAE_weighted = MAE_weighted,
      R2_pooled = R2_pooled,
      N_test_total = n_test_total
    )
  }
}

metrics_summary_min <- rbindlist(out_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
print(metrics_summary_min[])

```
